name: liveux/file-manager-bundle
description: Zero-dependency Symfony UX File Manager & DAM (TwigComponent, Stimulus, Flysystem, AssetMapper & Encore) with 9 themes, 6 icon sets, 12 languages, 9 editors, EasyAdmin 4/5, S3 & AI Skills.

suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required alongside league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3 for S3-compatible storage
suggest.doctrine/dbal: Optional database-backed folder & file metadata storage (defaults.metadata.driver: doctrine)
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: Optional Symfony Doctrine integration for DBAL metadata storage
suggest.ext-gd: Recommended for fast automatic WebP/JPEG thumbnail generation
suggest.ext-zip: Recommended for multi-file ZIP archive downloads and safe extraction
suggest.league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3: Required for AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Supabase Storage, or Backblaze B2 volumes
suggest.symfony/ai-bundle: Optional: registers Symfony AI Platform services used by the AI enrichment bridge
suggest.symfony/ai-platform: Optional AI Vision & Text auto-tagging, alt-text, and caption enrichment (SymfonyAiAssetEnricher is auto-registered when installed)
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: Recommended for zero-build Stimulus & CSS asset delivery
suggest.symfony/console: Recommended for CLI maintenance commands (doctor, cache:clear, thumbs:warmup, images:optimize, skills:install)
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: Recommended for Role/Voter RBAC permissions and user-scoped {user_id} paths
suggest.symfony/translation: Recommended for 12 built-in UI languages (en, tr, fr, de, es, ar, it, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh_CN)
suggest.symfony/yaml: Recommended for bundled English fallback translations when symfony/translation is absent
